value.rationale: Triangle counts and *open* wedges are jointly used as clustering/transitivity diagnostics; their covariance determines calibration of joint null diagnostics. A strict sign at every fixed-edge level, its sharp boundary degeneracies and opposite sign below an explicit independent-edge threshold constitute a nontrivial structural phenomenon absent from marginal moments, motivated by distinct graph null models.
